Keep this in sync with whatever the actual reading-text file's ref column uses if either ever changes. `units[]` is a straight transcription of joshua_literary_unit_map.md (Phase 1) -- not a second literary-critical pass, Lane already confirmed the map as-is. insight.example: so that you may act with insight wherever you go (1:7)
insight.echo: 1 Kgs 2:3 — David's dying charge to Solomon: keep what is written in the torah of Moses 'so that you may act with insight in all you do.' Joshua 1 is the template for a king.

listen.echo: Deut 34:9 — 'the sons of Israel listened to him,' Joshua, as the Torah closes. The same verb opens the Shema (Deut 6:4).

murmur.gloss: read or recite aloud in a low voice, mutter
murmur.example: you shall murmur it day and night (1:8)
murmur.echo: Ps 1:2–3 — on Yahweh's torah he murmurs day and night, and everything he does succeeds: the same verb, the same hours, the same promise.

shatter.gloss: be shattered, lose courage, be dismayed
shatter.example: do not tremble and do not shatter (1:9)
shatter.echo: Deut 31:8 — Moses to Joshua: 'do not fear and do not shatter.' Yahweh now repeats Moses' words.

valor.gloss: mighty man, man of strength — a stock military phrase
valor.echo: Judg 6:12 — the angel greets Gideon as a 'mighty man of valor'; Ruth 2:1 gives Boaz the same title.

clear.gloss: clear, innocent, released from an obligation
clear.echo: Gen 24:8, 41 — Abraham's servant will be 'clear of this oath of mine' if the woman will not come. Another oath, another woman, the same way out.

cord.echo: Hos 2:15 — 'the Valley of Achor a door of hope (tiqvah)': Hosea joins Rahab's word to Achor, the valley of Achan's judgment (Josh 7:24–26).

dig.echo: Deut 1:22 — the first generation asked for men to 'dig out the land for us': the spy mission that ended in forty years of wandering.

dread.echo: Exod 15:16 — 'dread and terror fall on them,' sung at the sea; Exod 23:27 — 'my dread I will send ahead of you.' Rahab reports it has happened.

hesed.gloss: loyalty that binds both parties; kindness owed and kept
hesed.echo: Ruth 3:10 — Boaz praises the ḥesed of Ruth, a foreign woman. Matthew makes Boaz Rahab's son (Matt 1:5).

rahab.echo: Matt 1:5 — 'Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab,' in Jesus' genealogy beside Tamar and Ruth. Heb 11:31 counts her faith; Jas 2:25 her works.

scarlet.gloss: scarlet, crimson (the dye and the thread)
scarlet.echo: Gen 38:28–30 — a scarlet thread tied on Zerah's hand at birth, in the story of Tamar, whom Judah took for a prostitute. Matt 1:3, 5 names Tamar and Rahab together.

soften.echo: Exod 15:15 — 'all who live in Canaan went soft': the same verb, in the song Israel sang at the sea.

shittim.gloss: Shittim, 'the acacias': the last camp east of the Jordan
shittim.echo: Num 25:1 — at Shittim Israel was drawn into the worship of Baal of Peor; Mic 6:5 later says 'remember... from Shittim to Gilgal,' naming this unit's two ends as proof of Yahweh's righteous acts.

holy.gloss: be holy; set apart, make holy

living.echo: Hos 1:10 — the same rare phrase: those called 'not my people' will be 'sons of a living God'; Pss 42:2 and 84:2 thirst for the living God; Matt 16:16 — Peter confesses 'the Son of the living God.'

heap.gloss: heap, a standing mass of water
heap.echo: Exod 15:8 — in the Song of the Sea the floods 'stood up like a heap'; Ps 78:13 repeats it. The Jordan does what the Reed Sea did, in the same rare word.

dry-ground.echo: Exod 14:21 — Yahweh drove the sea back all night and made it dry ground.

dry-land.gloss: be dry, dry up; dry land
dry-land.echo: Gen 1:9–10 — God gathers the waters and the dry land appears; Exod 14:16, 22 — Israel walks through the sea on dry land. Creation, then exodus, now the Jordan.

fixed.gloss: be fixed, firm; make ready, appoint

arrayed.echo: Exod 13:18 — Israel went up out of Egypt arrayed for battle, the same rare word. The eastern tribes enter the land the way the nation left Egypt.
